name: Rebels
notes: A small crew. They spend a little, and they don't call a room home until it has earned it.

name: Ravers
notes: They arrive in a pack and pay a normal night. If the floor is right, they are back the next time.

name: Queers
notes: They come with their people and they'll spend on a night that feels made for them. Once it does, they belong quickly.

name: Young Crowd
notes: A big group, and they want it cheap. They fill a room and then try the next one. This place becomes theirs slowly, if it does at all.

name: Elite
notes: Two or three at a table. They will spend, and a cheap or sloppy night sends them away. They are the last to become regulars.

name: Artists
notes: A few people who came for the work, not the bill. They come back when the night keeps being about something.
